html:
Nadia Comăneci is a Romanian gymnast, born in 1961 in Onești in Moldavia, who at the 1976 Montreal Olympics, aged 14, scored the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics.

The scoreboard could show only three digits and displayed 1.00. She scored seven perfect 10s in Montreal and won three gold medals, then two more at Moscow in 1980. She was trained by Béla and Márta Károlyi, who later moved to the United States. A national heroine under Ceaușescu, she was closely watched by the state. In November 1989, weeks before the revolution, she escaped on foot across the border to Hungary and went on to the United States. Her success made Romania a gymnastics power for decades.
sum: Nadia Comăneci is a Romanian gymnast, born in 1961 in Onești in Moldavia, who at the 1976 Montreal Olympics, aged 14, scored the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics.
